title: Diverse phage defence systems define West African South American pandemic Vibrio cholerae
authors: Adams DW; Jaskólska M; Lemopoulos A; Stutzmann S; Righi L; Bader L; Blokesch M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究霍乱弧菌谱系中多种抗噬菌体防御系统，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
Summary

Our understanding of the factors underlying the evolutionary success of different lineages of pandemic Vibrio cholerae remains incomplete. Interestingly, two unique genetic signatures define the West African South American (WASA) lineage of V. cholerae responsible for the 1991-2001 Latin American cholera epidemic. Here we show these signatures encode diverse anti-phage defence systems. Firstly, the WASA-1 prophage encodes a 2-gene abortive-infection system WonAB that renders the lineage resistant to the major predatory vibriophage ICP1, which alongside other phages, is thought to restrict cholera epidemics and has potential for use in prophylaxis. Secondly, a unique set of genes on the Vibrio seventh pandemic island II encodes an unusual modification-dependent restriction system targeting phages with modified genomes, and a new member of the Shedu defence family that defends against vibriophage X29. Taken together, we propose that these anti-phage defence systems have likely contributed to the success of a major epidemic lineage of the ongoing seventh cholera pandemic.
abstract_zh:
摘要

我们对不同大流行霍乱弧菌谱系进化成功背后因素的理解仍不完整。有趣的是，两个独特的遗传特征定义了导致1991-2001年拉丁美洲霍乱流行的西非南美（WASA）霍乱弧菌谱系。在此，我们展示这些特征编码了多样的抗噬菌体防御系统。首先，WASA-1前噬菌体编码一个双基因流产感染系统WonAB，使该谱系对主要捕食性弧菌噬菌体ICP1具有抗性，而ICP1与其他噬菌体一起被认为限制了霍乱流行，并具有预防应用的潜力。其次，第七次大流行岛II上的一个独特基因集编码了一个不寻常的修饰依赖性限制系统，靶向具有修饰基因组的噬菌体，以及Shedu防御家族的一个新成员，该成员防御弧菌噬菌体X29。综合来看，我们提出这些抗噬菌体防御系统可能促进了当前第七次霍乱大流行中一个主要流行谱系的成功。
